settings.question: Are your products 100% eggless?
settings.answer: Yes — every cake and dessert we make is 100% eggless, prepared in a pure-vegetarian, hygienic kitchen.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside Meerut?
settings.answer: We currently deliver across Meerut city and nearby areas. Contact us on WhatsApp to check availability for your location.

settings.question: How can I place a custom order?
settings.answer: Choose your options here, or tap WhatsApp Customization to share a reference photo and personalise your cake with our team.

settings.question: What is the shelf life of the cake?
settings.answer: Best enjoyed fresh on the day of delivery. Refrigerated, it stays good for up to 24 hours.
